title: Industrial Design Engineering Intern – Summer 2027
note: Industrial design for power tools despite the title; for ID majors, no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Summer industrial design internship supporting SBD's tool brands (DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, STANLEY, etc.) out of Towson.
facts.duties: Help create concept directions, brand aesthetics and ergonomic solutions; photoreal renderings and animations in 3D CAD and KeyShot; support the UX/UI team on product interfaces and apps; collaborate with designers and other disciplines.
facts.requirements: ID/product design major, graduating 2026 or 2027; analog and digital sketching/rendering; parametric 3D modeling a plus; portfolio.
facts.apply: Apply on SBD Workday (posted today, canApply true).
